answer: Bonded stake with graduated slashing: identity registration requires a bond B, and each attestation locks collateral. Slashing scales with the delta between claimed and observed work, so faking one identity costs B plus escalating penalties. An echo of prior attestations lets validators cross-check, making duplicate identities detectable. To forge k identities profitably, an attacker spends k·B while rewards stay linear, so break-even requires >60% honest overlap. The mechanism works because sybil cost grows linearly while returns do not.
